notes: Target: Ethereum mainnet (chainId 1), with $poolManager resolved to 0x000000000004444c5dc75cB358380D2e3dE08A90 and $token to the SIMDTEST token deployed first. Deploy SIMDTESTHook directly at a CREATE2-mined address whose low 14 bits equal 0x20c8, then initialize its pool atomically. beforeInitialize accepts the SIMDTEST/IMD pair with fee 12500 and tickSpacing 60, and records the opening block and timestamp. All enabled callbacks require the PoolManager caller. initialPrice is decimal sqrtPriceX96 for provenance; the launch factory selects the opening price from launch economics. The static 1.25% LP fee remains in effect throughout; the hook never overrides it or enables dynamic fees. On buys, the additional IMD fee is 3000 - 300 * elapsedBlocks bps for elapsedBlocks 0 through 9, and zero from block 10. The rate applies to gross IMD spent, with integer rounding down. Exact-input and exact-output fees use the specified and unspecified components, respectively, of the beforeSwap return delta. Reverted quotes account for partial fills without persisting quote state. Fees accrue as IMD ERC-6909 claims owned by the hook, with no fee conversion or burn of IMD. Anyone may call sweep() to redeem claims and transfer donated IMD to the fixed treasury 0x3dd5f73dd1a4e62630fad3909673f130ad429985. afterSwap checks actual positive SIMDTEST delivery: while limitActive() is true, amounts above maxBuy() (1e25 base units, 10,000,000 tokens) revert with MaxBuyExceeded; exactly the limit succeeds. The limit ends at openedAt + 3600 seconds and is per swap. Sells carry no hook fee or buy cap. SIMDTEST is a plain 18-decimal ERC-20 with no constructor arguments, transfer tax or token-level hooks; its entire 1e27-unit supply is minted to its deployer. No owner, admin setters, proxy or upgradeability. Supply distribution is external launch policy, not configured by this manifest.
